C2.speaker: Yoshua Bengio
C2.role: Co-chair, UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI
C2.transcript: Citizens and governments should not accept the companies' claim that they are trapped in a race. The race is not a law of nature. It is the product of choices.

K1.speaker: E. O. Wilson
K1.transcript: …modern humanity is distinguished by Paleolithic emotions and medieval institutions like banks and religions and godlike technology.

C1.speaker: Yuval Noah Harari
C1.transcript: …if for every $10 we spend on developing artificial intelligence, we could invest at least $1 in developing our consciousness, I think we'll be okay. But this is not the current trajectory we are on.
